newsitem.title: USA: Purus says Winstead named CEO, CFO.
newsitem.headline: Purus says Winstead named CEO, CFO.

text.p: Purus Inc said on Wednesday Donald Winstead was named as the company's chairman of the board of directors, chief executive officer, chief financial officer and secretary.
Purus said Russell Burbank resigned as interim chief executive officer.
The company did not say who Winstead replaced as chief financial officer.
It also announced the resignation of KPMG Peat Marwick LLP as its independent auditor.
Later, Winstead said he replaced Steven Mayer, who was filling in as chief financial officer.
Reinhard Seigrist resigned as chairman and will remain a director.
